1. Question: How can I update my contact details? Answer: You can update your phone number, email address, and other details in the “Profile Settings” section of the student portal.
2. Question: I am unable to log in even after resetting my password. What should I do? Answer: Please clear your browser cache and try again. If the issue continues, use the AI chatbot on the login page for further assistance.
3. Question: How can I download my fee receipt? Answer: You can download your fee receipt from the “Fees & Payments” section in your student dashboard.
4. Question: Can I change my enrolled course after registration? Answer: Course change requests can be submitted through the “Academic Requests” section, subject to approval by the administration.
5. Question: How do I check my class timetable? Answer: Your class timetable is available in the “Timetable” section of the student portal.
6. Question: I missed an exam. What should I do? Answer: Please submit a re-exam or special consideration request through the “Examination” section with valid supporting documents.
7. Question: How can I contact my course instructor? Answer: You can find instructor contact details in the “Faculty” section or send a message through the portal’s communication feature.
8. Question: How do I track the status of my request? Answer: You can track the status of any submitted request in the “My Requests” section of your dashboard.
9. Question: When will the semester results be published? Answer: Results are published as per the academic calendar. You will receive a notification once they are available.
10. Question: How can I apply for a bonafide certificate? Answer: You can apply for a bonafide certificate through the “Certificate Requests” section in the student portal.
